name: Weapon X Program
description: The shadowy Weapon X program abducts mutants and forges them into living weapons through brutal experimentation. Wolverine was just the beginning—now Romulus pulls the strings behind an entire lineage of weaponized killers.
flavorText: They made him a weapon. They forgot he was also a man.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Suspense / Tension Build. Black-ops Weapon X mutant experimentation. Cold clinical strings and metallic screams. Dark and experimental, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
